candidates.background: Hoppy Haden is the incumbent Caldwell County Judge. record.text: As a commissioner he chaired a host agreement advisory committee on a proposed landfill and worked with TxDOT on funding to widen Highway 21, according to his 2017 candidate profile.

notes.text: Won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary over former County Judge Ken Schawe, 2,122 votes to 1,336.

In July 2026 a local group, the Caldwell Data Center Action Team, called for his resignation and asked the Texas Rangers, the Attorney General's Office, and the district attorney to investigate after he disclosed signing a pre-sale agreement on his land with a company exploring a data center; Haden denied a conflict of interest, said he filed a conflict disclosure and would recuse himself from county matters involving the property, and said he would not resign. No investigation had been reported opened as of that report.
CBS Austin confirmed that a land-buying company owner gave $17,000 to his campaign since February 2026.
Local coverage in December 2025 described the 2026 Republican primary against former Judge Ken Schawe, who served from 2015 to 2018, as competitive.
